item.tib: skyabs gnas spyi 'dus kyi rtsa sgrub bla ma mchod pa'i chog khrigs bdud rtsi bum bzang
item.coloph: zhes skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i sgrub pa 'di yang / rgyal ba dgongs pa'i zhal rgyun dang / rgyud gzhan la mi 'dug bsam pa ma yin rung / rang 'dra'i blo dman thos chung rnams dang / yang khyad mnga' ris bstod (stod) du bon gyi bka' dpe med pa'i stobs kyis bon gyi bstan pa'i rgyan du khyung dkar sprang 'khyams grub ming 'bod pas gang dran gang shar du/ chu pho stag lo dpal yang ston bsam gtan gling du smras/ mtshal kha phun tshogs gling du bris/ chu mo yos lor yol mo gangs kyi ra ba stag phug seng ge rdzong du grub zin pa/ 'gro kun gyi dpal du bkra shis su gyur cig/
